title: You Died [Backport]
description: Adds a Dark Souls inspired death screen
body:
You Died

This mod adds a Dark Souls inspired death screen.

[Death Screen Showcase](https://i.imgur.com/HLkriU1.gif)

Backport of the original "You Died" mod. Displays a Dark Souls style "YOU DIED" message instead of the standard death screen and plays the accompanying death sound effect.

 

Credit to the original mod : https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/you-died
